tool_description: Python environment management for conda and venv. Discovers all environments under C:/Users/beren, compares package lists, checks health with pip check, and suggests the right environment for each project.

available_commands.description: Discover and list all conda and venv environments
List all packages installed in a specific environment
Compare two environments — shows packages only in each and version differences
Run pip check on an environment to find broken dependencies
Detect which environment a project uses (local venv, conda env, etc.)
Find packages installed at different versions across environments

tool_usage_guidance: Use list_environments first to see all available environment names
Use check_health on an environment before running Anna to catch broken dependencies early
Use compare_environments to understand differences between conda base and a project venv
Use check_project_environment to confirm which Python Anna is using for a project
find_duplicates checks the first 8 environments to avoid being too slow
Requires conda to be on PATH for conda environment discovery
proactive_triggers: When user asks 'what Python environments do I have?'
When user asks which environment to use for a project
When user asks to compare two environments
When user asks if their environment is healthy or has broken dependencies

metadata.notes: Disabled by default — listing packages runs pip list in each environment which can be slow. Enable when needed.
